metadata.case_name: LEUNG LAI CHUN v. MTR CORPORATION LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: flower shop assistant until the flower shop closed in 2015; not working at time of trial and depending on her son's income

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the right foot
source: the injury is of a minor nature which does not involve any fracture or open wound. It only resulted in soft tissue injury
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of ankle or foot, unspecified

manifestations.description: decreasing range of movement over right lateral foot
tenderness over the lateral side of the right foot
intermittent numbness in the right foot
tenderness over the 4th to 5th metatarsal bone of the right foot

treatments_received.treatment: A&E assessment and treatment; discharged with 5 days sick leave
source: When she was first admitted to the A&E department of Tuen Mun Hospital on the day of the accident, it was found that she had “redness, swelling and decreasing range of movement over right lateral foot (sic)”. She was treated and discharged and 5 days of sick leave was given to her.
In the physiotherapy progress report dated 6 October 2011, it was recommended by the physiotherapist that the plaintiff was fit to be discharged after 4 sessions of physiotherapy.

on subsequent visits to the general out-patient clinic by the plaintiff (initiated by her rather than by way of follow-up treatment), no further objective physical findings like swelling, bruises, or redness was recorded anymore.
